+def test_prioritized_identifier_equality_order_and_json() -> None:
+    timestamp = datetime(2024, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
+    first = PrioritizedIdentifier("9780123456786", timestamp=timestamp)
+    same = PrioritizedIdentifier(
+        "9780123456786", stage_import=False, priority=Priority.HIGH
+    )
+    asin = PrioritizedIdentifier("B06XYHVXVJ", priority=Priority.HIGH)
+
+    assert len({first, same, asin}) == 2
+    assert first == same
+    assert first != asin
+    assert asin < first
+    assert json.loads(json.dumps(first.to_dict())) == {
+        "identifier": "9780123456786",
+        "stage_import": True,
+        "priority": "LOW",
+        "timestamp": "2024-01-02T03:04:05",
+    }
+    assert same.to_dict()["stage_import"] is False
+    assert PrioritizedISBN(isbn="9780123456786").isbn == first.identifier
+    assert PrioritizedISBN("9780123456786", Priority.HIGH).priority == Priority.HIGH
+

+def test_process_amazon_batch_only_stages_requested_items(monkeypatch) -> None:
+    products = [
+        {"isbn_10": [], "isbn_13": [], "source_records": ["amazon:B06XYHVXVJ"]},
+        {
+            "isbn_10": ["0123456789"],
+            "isbn_13": ["9780123456786"],
+            "source_records": ["amazon:0123456789"],
+        },
+    ]
+    api = MagicMock()
+    api.get_products.return_value = products
+    batch = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(affiliate_server.web, "amazon_api", api, raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(affiliate_server.stats, "increment", MagicMock())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(affiliate_server.cache.memcache_cache, "set", MagicMock())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        affiliate_server.config, "infobase", {"db_parameters": True}, raising=False
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(affiliate_server, "get_current_amazon_batch", lambda: batch)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        affiliate_server, "clean_amazon_metadata_for_load", lambda product: product
+    )
+
+    process_amazon_batch(
+        [
+            PrioritizedIdentifier("B06XYHVXVJ", stage_import=False),
+            PrioritizedIdentifier("0123456789", stage_import=True),
+        ]
+    )
+
+    api.get_products.assert_called_once_with(
+        ["B06XYHVXVJ", "0123456789"], serialize=True
+    )
+    batch.add_items.assert_called_once_with(
+        [
+            {
+                "ia_id": "amazon:0123456789",
+                "status": "staged",
+                "data": products[1],
+            }
+        ]
+    )
